title: Derived Hom and isomorphism presheaves on the etale site
statement: For a scheme $X$ with small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], a commutative ring $B$ and $K,L$ in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of sheaves of $B$-modules, define presheaves $V\mapsto\operatorname{Hom}_{D(V_{et},B)}(K|_V,L|_V)$ and $V\mapsto\operatorname{Isom}_{D(V_{et},B)}(K|_V,L|_V)$. Restriction along $U\to V$ is exact etale inverse image, conjugated by its canonical composition comparisons with the restrictions from $X$. These restriction functions satisfy the identity and composition laws, for both morphisms and isomorphisms.
